resources.string: Recording audio. Tap to return to WeMeet.
Recording has ended. Finish uploading and confirm the saved audio.
You can leave this page or lock your screen. Pause from the recording notification.
Recording continues when you leave or lock your screen. Notifications are off; return here to pause or finish.
Your saved audio is kept. Resume recording, or finish and save the available audio.
Record an in-person meeting or interview. You can find the saved audio in meeting records.
Recording could not start. Allow microphone access and finish any active meeting, then try again.
This action could not be confirmed. Your local recovery data is kept. Retry to check its status.
Audio is saved privately on this device and uploaded in the background.
Audio has been saved. This recording will not resume automatically.
Stop recording and save the audio. If an upload fails, the local audio stays available for retry.
